response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT ra.circuitId, c.country, ra.round FROM races ra JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = ra.circuitId), cc AS (SELECT country, AVG(round) AS country_avg FROM r GROUP BY country) SELECT r.circuitId, r.country, AVG(r.round) AS circuit_avg_round, AVG(r.round) - cc.country_avg AS diff FROM r JOIN cc ON cc.country = r.country GROUP BY r.circuitId, r.country, cc.country_avg ORDER BY diff DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
